headline: How ConvertPolo Helped Beyond By Vera Increase Revenue by 52.83% Through Strategic Cart & PDP Optimizations
overview:
Beyond By Vera is a premium fashion and lifestyle brand offering contemporary apparel designed for modern women. With a strong focus on quality, style, and a seamless online shopping experience, the brand attracts customers looking for elevated everyday fashion.

As more customers started shopping on mobile, making the buying journey smoother became a priority. So, Beyond By Vera partnered with ConvertPolo to optimize key buying moments, from product pages to cart interactions, to increase conversions and revenue.
challenge:
Beyond By Vera's purchase journey had several friction points that impacted conversions and revenue:

Interrupted purchase flow: Customers had to leave the current page to review or modify their cart, disrupting their browsing experience and adding unnecessary steps before checkout.

Missed cart recovery opportunities: Shoppers who abandoned their cart weren't given a compelling, well-timed prompt to continue their purchase, resulting in lost conversion opportunities.

Reduced CTA visibility: As shoppers scrolled through product images, descriptions, reviews, and sizing information, the Add to Cart button disappeared from view, creating friction before purchase.
solutions: Introduced a Sticky Add to Cart bar that kept the primary purchase CTA visible throughout the product page.
Implemented a Cart Drawer that enabled shoppers to view, edit, and review their cart without leaving the current page.
Launched a dedicated Cart Recovery pop-up to re-engage shoppers who were about to leave, encouraging them to complete their order.

experiments.title: Sticky Add to Cart
experiments.problem: The Add to Cart button disappeared as users scrolled through product images, descriptions, reviews, and sizing information, making it less convenient to purchase.
experiments.hypothesis: If the Add to Cart button remains visible while users browse the product page, they will be more likely to add products to their cart without interrupting their shopping journey.
experiments.conclusion: Keeping the primary purchase CTA constantly visible reduced friction during product exploration, making it easier for shoppers to act when they were ready to buy.

experiments.title: Cart Drawer
experiments.problem: Users had to leave their current page to review or edit their cart, interrupting the shopping journey and adding unnecessary friction before checkout.
experiments.hypothesis: If users can view, edit, and review their cart through a slide-out drawer without leaving the current page, they will progress to checkout more frequently.
experiments.conclusion: By allowing shoppers to manage their cart without disrupting their browsing experience, the buying journey became faster and more seamless, encouraging more users to continue to checkout.

experiments.title: Cart Recovery Popup
experiments.problem: The existing cart recovery pop-up relied on a third-party app, limiting customization and slowing down optimization efforts.
experiments.hypothesis: If the cart recovery pop-up is developed in-house, the brand can deliver a more optimized recovery experience with greater flexibility and control.
experiments.conclusion: Owning the entire cart recovery experience enabled faster optimization and a more effective recovery flow, leading to stronger purchase intent and higher revenue.

stats.label: Increase in Buy Now Button Clicks

overallImpact: By optimizing key moments in the purchase journey, Beyond By Vera created a faster and more seamless shopping experience. A persistent Add to Cart CTA reduced friction on product pages, the Cart Drawer simplified the path to checkout, and the in-house cart recovery experience encouraged more shoppers to complete their purchases. Together, these improvements made it easier for customers to buy with confidence, resulting in higher engagement, stronger checkout progression, and significant revenue growth.

impactStats.label: Rise in Buy Now Button Clicks

headline: How Better Product Discovery Drove 68.39% Revenue Growth for Deodap
overview:
Deodap is one of India's largest ecommerce platform offering over 17,000 products across categories including Home & Living, Kitchen, Tech & Gadgets, Beauty, Fashion, Toys, Office Supplies, and more, with a strong focus on affordable everyday products.

Deodap partnered with ConvertPolo to improve product discovery by making it easier for shoppers to navigate its extensive catalog. The focus was on reducing browsing friction, helping users find relevant products faster, and building trust early in the shopping journey.
challenge:
The browsing experience created friction across key product discovery touchpoints.

Navigating a large catalog was overwhelming: With thousands of products available, users had to browse long lists or rely on the filter drawer to find relevant items.

Filtering required extra effort: Sorting and filtering options disappeared while scrolling, making it inconvenient for users to refine product listings.

Trust was not established early: The homepage lacked visible trust signals, giving first-time visitors fewer reasons to feel confident about exploring the store.
solutions: Added horizontally scrollable category filter chips below the Filters/Sort bar on collection pages, allowing users to quickly jump into relevant product categories without opening the filter drawer.
Introduced a sticky Sort & Filter bar on mobile collection pages so users could refine product listings at any point while browsing.
Added trust seals on the homepage to communicate credibility and reassure shoppers from the very beginning of their journey.

experiments.title: Category Filter Chips on Collection Page
experiments.problem: With over 11,000 products, users struggled to quickly discover relevant items and had to rely on the filter drawer to narrow their search.
experiments.hypothesis: If we add horizontally scrollable category filter chips below the Filters/Sort bar, users can find relevant products faster, reducing browsing friction and increasing conversions.
experiments.conclusion: Helping shoppers self-segment into relevant categories made product discovery faster and encouraged more purchases.

experiments.title: Sticky Sort & Filter on Product Listing Page
experiments.problem: The Sort & Filter controls disappeared as users scrolled, making it harder to refine product listings during browsing.
experiments.hypothesis: If the Sort & Filter bar remains sticky while users browse, they can refine products anytime, leading to better product discovery and higher conversions.
experiments.conclusion: Keeping refinement tools accessible throughout the browsing journey encouraged more engagement and purchases.

experiments.title: Trust Seals on Homepage
experiments.problem: The homepage lacked visible trust signals, making it harder for first-time visitors to feel confident shopping on the website.
experiments.hypothesis: If we display trust and payment seals on the homepage, users will feel more confident, leading to higher purchase intent and increased revenue.
experiments.conclusion: Building trust at the very beginning of the customer journey encouraged more shoppers to continue and complete their purchases.

overallImpact: By improving product discovery and reducing friction across the browsing journey, Deodap turned product exploration into a stronger driver of conversions. Category shortcuts made it easier for shoppers to find relevant products, sticky filtering encouraged deeper browsing, and early trust signals increased confidence from the very first interaction. Together, these optimizations helped more users discover products, engage with listings, and progress toward purchase.

headline: How ConvertPolo Optimized DeoDap's PLP and PDP Experience to Improve Product Discovery and Revenue
overview:
DeoDap is an eCommerce platform offering a wide range of products across multiple categories. With a large product catalog, helping shoppers discover relevant products, build trust, and make confident purchase decisions was critical to improving the shopping experience.

DeoDap partnered with ConvertPolo to identify and reduce friction across key moments in the shopping journey. The focus was on improving product discovery on the PLP, building trust on product pages, and creating stronger purchase motivation through targeted CRO experiments.
challenge:
DeoDap's shopping journey faced friction at different stages of product evaluation and purchase.

Product discovery gaps: The existing Filter & Sort experience made it harder for users to narrow down products and discover relevant options efficiently.

Trust gaps: Product pages lacked contextual social proof that could help shoppers feel more confident about their purchase decisions.

Low purchase urgency: PDPs lacked clear urgency cues around product availability, giving users little motivation to act immediately.
solutions: The PLP Filter & Sort experience was upgraded to make product discovery and navigation easier.
Location-based social proof was introduced on PDPs to add contextual trust and strengthen purchase confidence.
Stock-count messaging was added to PDPs to create urgency around product availability and encourage faster purchase decisions.

experiments.title: PLP Filter & Sort Upgrade
experiments.problem: DeoDap's PLP had low product-card interaction and product discoverability. Users could face friction when trying to narrow down the large selection and find relevant products.
experiments.hypothesis: If we upgrade the Filter & Sort UI, users will be able to find products more easily, increasing interaction with the product listing and driving more add-to-cart actions.
experiments.conclusion: A more intuitive filtering experience made product discovery easier and encouraged users to engage further with products.

experiments.title: Location-Based Social Proof
experiments.problem: DeoDap's PDPs lacked genuine, contextual social proof that could reassure shoppers and strengthen trust in the product and website.
experiments.hypothesis: If we show location-based social proof on the PDP, users will feel greater trust and motivation to purchase, leading to higher revenue.
experiments.conclusion: Contextual social proof helped strengthen trust at a critical point in the purchase journey

experiments.title: Stock Urgency
experiments.problem: DeoDap's PDPs lacked urgency cues around product availability, which could leave shoppers with little reason to act immediately.
experiments.hypothesis: If we show stock-count urgency on PDPs, users will feel greater motivation to purchase, increasing add-to-cart actions and orders.
experiments.conclusion: Adding clear stock-availability cues created urgency and encouraged shoppers to act rather than postpone their purchase.

overallImpact: By addressing friction across the shopping journey, DeoDap turned product discovery, trust, and urgency into conversion opportunities. Better filtering improved discovery, social proof built confidence, and stock urgency encouraged faster purchase decisions.

headline: How Andaaz Fashion achieved 125% increase in revenue
overview:
Andaaz Fashion is an online ethnic clothing store that provides exclusive designer Indian clothes for enthusiasts who are interested in vibrant and chic women's ethnic clothes all over the world. They carry a wide variety of Indian dresses like Salwar Kameez, Sarees, Anarkali Suits, Lehengas, Men's Kurta Pajama, Kids Wear, Wedding Dresses, Festival Wear, etc.

They partnered with ConvertPolo to increase their overall E-commerce Conversion Rate and boost revenue.
challenge: The existing search bar lacked relevant autocomplete suggestions, had a clunky interface, and showed no visual cues like images or categories, resulting in high search exits and lost purchase opportunities. On mobile, users struggled to get essential product information quickly, slowing down decision-making and reducing confidence. Users faced friction while filtering and navigating product options on mobile, leading to lower engagement and missed conversions.
solutions: Introduced smart autocomplete suggestions, predictive search results, and improved search navigation to streamline product discovery.
Enhanced the first product card image on mobile by adding dynamic elements such as product videos, key features, delivery timelines, and contextual recommendation tags.
Redesigned the mobile PLP by surfacing customer reviews in the first fold and implementing unenclosed sticky filter and sort options, with embedded color and price filters between product tiles.

experiments.title: Landing Page Optimization
experiments.problem: Users faced friction while filtering and navigating product options on mobile, leading to lower engagement and missed conversions.
experiments.hypothesis: If we redesign the Product Listing Page (PLP) by placing customer reviews in the first fold to offer reassurance through positive stories like fast delivery, and implement an unenclosed, sticky filter and sort feature on mobile—along with embedding a color filter and price filter between product tiles to enhance contextual product discovery, then users will experience greater trust and ease in navigation, leading to improved product discovery, increased engagement, and higher conversion rates.
experiments.conclusion: A seamless, intelligent search experience directly boosts engagement and drives purchase actions, especially for ready-to-buy users.

experiments.title: Social Proof On Product Display Page
experiments.problem: On the product display page, users lacked reassurance about the product's popularity and trustworthiness, leading to hesitation and drop-offs during the decision-making stage.
experiments.hypothesis: If we introduce social proof elements on the product display page, such as “X people have this in their cart” or real-time popularity indicators, then the conversion rate will increase.
experiments.conclusion: Making value-rich product content visible at first glance significantly accelerates user confidence and purchase decisions on mobile.

experiments.title: Search Experience Optimization
experiments.problem: The existing search bar lacked relevant autocomplete suggestions, had a clunky interface, and showed no visual cues like images or categories—resulting in high search exits and lost purchase opportunities.
experiments.hypothesis: If we make the search experience more seamless by introducing smart suggestions, predictive results and intuitive navigation, then high-intent users, those actively looking for specific products, will be able to discover and land on relevant PDPs faster, leading to a higher conversion rate and an improved user experience.
experiments.conclusion: A seamless, intelligent search experience directly boosts engagement and drives purchase actions, especially for ready-to-buy users.

overallImpact: Through these strategic UX and content enhancements, Andaaz Fashion achieved major gains in engagement, conversion, and revenue. These experiments validate that simplifying discovery, improving trust cues, and delivering richer content upfront are powerful levers in driving eCommerce growth.

headline: AnotherSole achieved 185% rise in revenue by improving product discovery and shopping journey
overview:
AnotherSole is a global footwear and lifestyle brand known for its minimalist aesthetic, responsibly crafted materials, and comfortable designs. With a strong international community and a commitment to conscious production, the brand attracts loyal shoppers who appreciate both quality and sustainable fashion.

Through focused experimentation AnotherSole was able to refine its user journey and significantly boost performance. These enhancements led to a 185% increase in revenue, a 22% rise in Add-to-Cart actions, and a notable uplift in overall conversion confidence across the funnel.
challenge: AnotherSole was attracting strong traffic but users weren't moving smoothly through the shopping journey. The search experience felt unguided, the product page lacked clarity and the cart flow involved unnecessary steps. All of these created friction that slowed product discovery and led to lower conversions.
solutions: Introduced popular searches and curated collections to guide exploration, making product discovery more intuitive and increasing engagement.
Brought key product details upfront, improved visual hierarchy and added sizing guidance and trust signals to simplify decision-making and boost purchase intent.
Combined product selection and discount application into a single streamlined step, reducing friction and minimizing drop-offs during checkout.

experiments.title: Search Experience Optimisation
experiments.problem: Product Search felt empty and unguided. Without popular searches or curated collections, users were unsure what to explore. It led to limited product engagement.
experiments.hypothesis: Highlighting popular searches and relevant collections would guide users toward better product discovery, leading to higher engagement and conversions.
experiments.conclusion: Guided search prompts reduced uncertainty and encouraged users to explore more confidently.

experiments.title: Product Page Revamp
experiments.problem: Key product details like sizing, value props, trust elements, and imagery hierarchy were unclear or buried, making purchase decisions harder.
experiments.hypothesis: Improving hierarchy, adding a clear “What's My Size?” guide, strengthening trust signals, and prioritizing imagery would boost user confidence and purchase intent.
experiments.conclusion: Reduced friction in decision-making, which helped users move faster from browsing to buying, improving overall Add-to-Cart rates.

experiments.title: Cart Flow Simplification
experiments.problem: Users had to add products first and then apply discount codes on a separate screen, causing friction and unnecessary drop-offs.
experiments.hypothesis: Merging both actions into a single, clean step would shorten the journey, reduce friction and improve conversions.
experiments.conclusion: Reduced friction in the purchase journey lead to fewer drop-offs and higher conversion rates.

stats.label: Increase in Thank You Page Visits

overallImpact: AnotherSole's transformation highlights how thoughtful UX refinement can shift the entire shopping experience. By nudging discovery, clarifying product details, and streamlining checkout, we turned uncertain interactions into smooth, confident buying journeys.
